Classifies Dubbo Triple failures by their preserved protocol status in RPC-preview telemetry instead of grouping them under `StatusRpcException`.

For example, a preserved client deadline failure produces:

```text
error.type = "DEADLINE_EXCEEDED"
```

Clients omit the redundant failure-only `rpc.response.status_code`. Server spans and duration metrics retain the response-status attribute when a Triple status is available, including statuses that are not classified as server errors.

Uses the exception class when no Triple status is available, including native Dubbo failures. Applies role-specific client/server error rules without adding bytecode hooks; response statuses unavailable at the existing filter boundary are not inferred.
metadata.title: Classify Dubbo Triple errors by protocol status
